## 3dslibris 3.0.0

It has been a while, but now you can search your books and zoom in on images!

This release also includes many fixes and improvements, including better support for CJK text, landscape orientation and handedness controls, and more.

### New

- #163: find words and phrases with the 3DS keyboard, highlight matches and move between results. Available in EPUB, MOBI, TXT, Markdown, FB2, RTF and ODT through the BOOK menu.
- #28: zoom and pan illustrations in EPUB, MOBI and FB2. Hold Y to select an image, then press A to open it. Includes touch controls and returns to your reading position.
- [#101](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/101): optional 800×240 top-screen mode for PDF, CBZ and XPS through `wide top screen` in the BOOK menu. Available on Old/New 3DS (including XL) and New 2DS XL; the original 2DS stays at 400×240.
- Optional `disable ebook images` setting under `style customization` (I also read YT comment hehe).

### Fixes and improvements

- Faster library browsing and EPUB page turns, smoother PDF panning and quicker app shutdown.
- Open PDFs fitted to the whole page and improve PDF/CBZ image scaling.
- EPUB books show the first page before the page cache finishes saving.
- Fix overlapping full-page images and preserve authored image sizes across reading screens.
- Correct orientation and handedness controls, landscape buttons, loading screens and partial redraws (I didn't try these for a while and some things were broken).
- Show two lines for library titles and load folder covers only when visible and idle.
- Fix a CJK pagination stack overflow (#165), parsing errors, image-loading limits and invalid page-cache handling.

### Updating

EPUB and MOBI page caches are rebuilt on first open after updating. Reading progress, bookmarks and preferences are kept. If you close the app while an EPUB cache is still being prepared, it may need rebuilding on the next open. Returning to the library finishes the pending save.

Search does not support PDF/CBZ/XPS, OCR or RTL text. See the [search guide](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/blob/main/docs/BOOK_SEARCH.md) and [image controls](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/blob/main/docs/IMAGE_VIEWER.md) for details.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone reporting issues and supporting the project. Special thanks to @Rhlp-Engineering and @Leblatar for supporting this version! You can help with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
